llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only, local garden tracker that creates and manages files under ~/garden; its requested actions and storage are coherent with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (garden tracker) align with what the skill does: create and maintain structured garden files (memory.md, climate.md, plants/, zones/, log/, harvests.md) and use them for planning, diagnostics, and logging. There are no unrelated binaries, environment variables, or cloud credentials requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions stay within the garden domain and only reference files under ~/garden. The only cross-domain behavior is an optional, explicit consent step to add an entry to the user's main memory file (e.g., MEMORY.md) so other sessions can see Garden is active. The skill repeatedly emphasizes explicit consent before writing outside ~/garden and asks to backup before modifying on version updates. Users should confirm which exact file path will be modified when consenting to workspace integration.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. This minimizes disk footprint and execution of third-party code. Nothing is downloaded or extracted.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are required. All data is local (~/garden). The optional workspace integration writes to a main memory file only with explicit consent; this is reasonable for the stated purpose but should be confirmed by the user.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (not force-included). The skill persists data in ~/garden by design. It does not request system-wide privileges or modify other skills' configurations. Autonomous invocation is allowed by default (platform normal) but presents standard LLM-skill autonomy — nothing here increases that privilege.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and stores everything under ~/garden, which is appropriate for a local garden tracker. Before installing: (1) Be prepared for the skill to create and write files in your home directory (~/garden/) and back up anything important there; (2) When the setup asks to 'register in your main memory' confirm exactly which file will be edited (path, content) before consenting — decline if you don't want any files outside ~/garden modified; (3) Verify you are comfortable with local storage of potentially sensitive metadata (location, climate, photos) since the skill keeps this data on disk; (4) Because it's instruction-only there is no third-party code to audit, but also no automated update/install mechanism — review updates and accept backups before upgrades.
